name.Description: The resource name of the singleton BI reservation. Reservation names have the form 'projects/{projectId}/locations/{locationId}/biReservation'.

preferred_tables.Description: Preferred tables to use BI capacity for.

dataset_id.Description: The ID of the dataset in the above project.

project_id.Description: The assigned project ID of the project.

table_id.Description: The ID of the table in the above dataset.

size.Description: Size of a reservation, in bytes.

update_time.Description:
The last update timestamp of a reservation.

A timestamp in RFC3339 UTC "Zulu" format, with nanosecond resolution and up to nine fractional digits. Examples: "2014-10-02T15:01:23Z" and "2014-10-02T15:01:23.045123456Z".
